Order
06.11.2025 Order No.
03. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.20 of 2025 pending in the Court of learned SDJM, Umerkote arising out of Umerkote P.S. Case No.09 of 2025 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 406/ 420/ 465/ 468/ 471/ 506 of IPC read with Section 66(C) of the I.T. Act, 2000.
3.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioners that the present Petitioners are the mother and wife of the principal accused who has since been released on bail by order dated 17.07.2025 by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge, Umerkote in B.A. No.65 of 2025 and referring to the complicity of the Petitioners
, it is submitted that the Petitioners have been cited as accused only because of their relationship with the principal accused as noted hereinabove.
Hence, they may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail and submits that this is an economic offence and there is money trail to the account of the present Petitioners.

5. Taking into account the role ascribed to the Petitioners and that they are ladies, it is directed that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioners shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to verification of B. Ramabai vs State Of Odisha ....

7. It is needless to state that the Petitioners shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
8. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
